name: algolia
summary: Run the storefront's search, its category facet and the header's search bar on Algolia.

env.name: ALGOLIA_APP_ID
env.comment: Your Algolia application ID (Algolia dashboard, Settings, API Keys)

env.name: ALGOLIA_API_KEY
env.comment: An Algolia API key that may write the index: the Write API key, or one with addObject, deleteObject, deleteIndex, editSettings, settings and search

env.name: ALGOLIA_INDEX
env.comment: The index the catalogue lives in (default products)

next: Run nymbal replay --to search once to fill the index from the catalogue; product changes keep it current after that.
A replace briefly holds the catalogue twice (a temporary index), so keep the catalogue under half your Algolia plan's record quota.
